summary: Updates RFC 9048 and RFC 5448 with an optional extension that adds an ephemeral key exchange to EAP-AKA'. When negotiated, it provides forward secrecy for the session keys generated in the authentication, so later key compromise does not expose past sessions.

eli5.summary: Each time your phone logs in, it makes a fresh one-time secret and throws it away. Even if a thief later learns the main password, they cannot unlock old conversations.

questions: how to add forward secrecy to eap-aka
